description: {image:minecraft:textures/item/writable_book.png width:48 height:48 align:center}
&6&lTHE ISLAND NEEDS A MEMORY
&fAn island becomes home when useful work survives the person who started it.
&fSeason One turns faction identity, public works, rivalries, and records into reasons to return.
&eRead the three reference clauses around this page, then sign the short charter below.&f They separate real hard protections from rules that only work because friends agree to honor them.
&8Leave behind something a later player can use.
quests.subtitle: Two minutes now; fewer arguments at 1:30 a.m.

tasks.title: Open the Charter

quests.title: OPEN THE ISLAND CHARTER

description: {image:minecraft:textures/item/filled_map.png width:48 height:48 align:center}
&a&lBUILD WHERE THE WORLD REMEMBERS
&fHomes, faction halls, markets, roads, memorials, public machines, and lore sites belong only on land the host has explicitly confirmed permanent.
&fAny announced reset zone is an expedition site, not a place for irreplaceable work. Claims are hard boundaries only where the live FTB Chunks configuration really enforces them.
&cNo prank, theft, faction stunt, or contract overrides another team's protected claim or explicit consent.
&8If the reset eats your cathedral, the cathedral was camping.
quests.subtitle: Permanent work needs a boundary that actually means something.

tasks.title: I Know the Permanent-Land and Claim Rule

quests.title: LAND, CLAIMS, AND RESET ZONES

description: {image:minecraft:textures/item/firework_rocket.png width:48 height:48 align:center}
&d&lTHE FUNNY WAR CLAUSE
&fVampires and Hunters may compete through banners, mascots, markets, races, scavenger hunts, public challenges, expeditions, ward demonstrations, architecture, and reversible wilderness mischief.
&fNeutrals may trade, mediate, scout, judge, rescue, courier, host, or sell services to either side without becoming a consolation faction.
&cNo claim intrusion, theft, spawn camping, targeted harassment, irreversible sabotage, or destruction wearing a comedy moustache.
&fCombat is a scheduled opt-in event only, with a host, backup, stop condition, protected noncombatants, and rebuild plan. Winning never grants progression power.
&8A prank with a cleanup crew is a bit. A crater is an incident.
quests.subtitle: Make stories, not support tickets.

tasks.title: I Accept the Rivalry and Optional-Combat Boundary

quests.title: RIVALRY, NEUTRALS, AND OPTIONAL COMBAT

description: {image:vampirism:textures/item/vampire_fang.png width:48 height:48 align:center}
&6&lONE BODY, ONE PARTY, TWO KINDS OF ALLEGIANCE
&fVampirism now provides real Vampire and Hunter factions. FTB Teams provides shared quest progress and FTB Chunks ownership. Season One uses both, but it does not automatically synchronize them.
&eA Vampirism advancement records that an event happened; it is not a live faction-state detector forever.
&fBefore a faction team claims shared foundation supplies, one teammate or the host confirms that the team is presently aligned with that faction.
&fAsk the host before joining, leaving, or switching an FTB party. Claims, storage, contracts, and quest history must be checked rather than guessed.
&8The bureaucracy has developed fangs.
quests.subtitle: Two faction systems exist. Do not pretend they are the same database.

tasks.title: I Understand Vampirism Faction vs FTB Team State

quests.title: VAMPIRISM, FTB TEAMS, AND SWITCHING

description: {image:minecraft:textures/item/writable_book.png width:48 height:48 align:center}
&6&lTHE FOUR-LINE VERSION
&f1. Build irreplaceable work only on confirmed permanent land.
&f2. Claims and consent outrank rivalry, contracts, and bits.
&f3. Combat is optional, scheduled, supervised, and reversible.
&f4. Vampirism faction state and FTB team state are separate; switches need a quick host review.
&7Lore:&f Nessa Quill signs as courier because Greybridge taught her that an agreement nobody can find is only a rumour.
&eObjective:&f Sign the charter after reading the three boundary clauses.

&aStandard:&f VvH progression grants one-time Bevels. Lighting, transit, and repair requisitions become available after the invitation welcome point; the post-season rumour is only a slow weekly fallback.
&6Starter nudge:&f one Compass and eight Torches.
quests.subtitle: Four boundaries, one signature, useful travel supplies.

tasks.title: Sign the Island Charter

quests.title: SIGN THE CHARTER

description: {image:minecraft:textures/item/compass_16.png width:48 height:48 align:center}
&6&lTHREE LEGITIMATE WAYS TO BELONG
&4Vampires&f gain a real supernatural progression and are asked to turn that identity into hospitality, ritual spaces, night infrastructure, and civic obligations.
&bHunters&f gain their own real progression and are asked to turn vigilance into safe roads, public knowledge, workshops, and reliable refuge.
&aNeutrals&f remain human/non-aligned and become the connective tissue: trade, contracts, mapping, MCA civic life, rescue, logistics, and arbitration.
&eNothing here is permanent.&f Switching is allowed, but it creates social and claim bookkeeping. Pick the role you actually want to play this week, not the reward you think is numerically best.
&8The Atlas has stopped pretending the word 'faction' is metaphorical.
quests.subtitle: Choose what kind of problem you want to become useful at.

tasks.title: Read All Three Invitations

quests.title: READ THE THREE INVITATIONS

description: &4&lLORE — THE HOUSE THAT MUST ANSWER
&fMirelle Voss still keeps the Greybridge truce in her throat. She failed to shelter people then; Nessa Quill carried the surviving guest list out by hand.
&fMirelle cannot say whether the failure was cowardice, a false instruction, or a door she thought was safe. She can say what the next House will do.
&eOBJECTIVE&f Choose the House of Night as your foundation after accepting the Crimson Invitation.
&7BUILD STANDARD&f Name the headquarters. Record whether its guest rule begins with anonymous shelter or a named ledger.
&fThe choice changes the House's first promise, not anyone's access to magic.

description: &a&lLORE — SLEEP WITHOUT EXPLANATION

&7BUILD STANDARD&f Provide a usable guest space, labelled storage, and an obvious lit exit.

&7Build Standard:&f Record the sender, destination, seal marks, and the correction made if the route was wrong. Solo players may submit a signed test log.

quests.title: PROGRESSION · COURIER UNDER TWO SEALS

&fNobody was hurt, but the door stayed sealed for three days. The Free Company now publishes safe examples.
&eObjective:&f Prepare a neutral spellwright service with Arcane Essence and demonstrate one safe utility procedure.
&7Build Standard:&f Show the prepared material and a signed procedure. A solo player may self-audit the demonstration.
quests.subtitle: Progression · make spell utility legible without claiming either faction's mastery.

REVIEW: We Used MCA/Civic Play to Create One Named Relationship or Place

&fThe rescue worked because someone had recorded who could help without starting a faction dispute.
&eObjective:&f Run one mediation or rescue procedure and record the result.
&7Build Standard:&f Name the problem, the neutral response, and the follow-up. Solo players may interact with an MCA resident or submit a self-audit.
quests.subtitle: Progression · resolve one real problem nobody owns by default.

tasks.title: A Posted Service Request Was Resolved or Reviewed
Carry a Recovery Compass

quests.title: PROGRESSION · MEDIATE OR RESCUE

description: &fLore:&f The translation desk began with a Blood rune, a Holy rune, and Nessa's refusal to copy either without a warning.
&fIts first useful result was not a weapon; it was one safe instruction that both sides could read.
&eObjective:&f Open the spell translation desk with Arcane Essence and document one limited Blood or Holy utility.
&7Build Standard:&f Keep the example available to visitors and record its safety limit.
quests.subtitle: Progression · translate utility, not allegiance.

&fAt least one route, service, or spell procedure must answer a visitor's question.
&eObjective:&f Complete any five of the eight Free Company works.
&7Build Standard:&f The five must include at least one world-building work and one progression/service work.
quests.subtitle: Five useful works make a neutral company people can rely on.

&fElias needs a ledger that says who can safely use what.
&fChoose any three specialty projects. The other five remain open choices, not a hidden eight-quest checklist.

tasks.title: Read the Eight Contribution Routes

&fObjective:&7 Present 4 Create Andesite Alloys, then demonstrate or solo-test one repeatable machine service and record its result.
&fStandard:&7 Another player may repeat the service; solo players sign the test with the observed result or failure.

quests.title: ENGINEER

description: &6Lore:&f Mirelle Voss translated a Greybridge ward from memory and reversed one line. The ward held, but it held the wrong doorway. She needs a method with a visible first step.
&fObjective:&7 Present 4 Arcane Essences, then demonstrate or solo-test one repeatable spell-preparation step and record its result.
&fStandard:&7 A partner may reproduce the step; solo players sign the test with the observed result or failure.
quests.subtitle: Service · make one spell step teachable

REVIEW: A Spell/Ingredient/Upgrade Tip Is Published

&fStandard:&7 Another player may follow the procedure; solo players sign the test with the observed result or failure.

chapters.title: VvH 05 · The Work Each Hand Knows

description: {image:minecraft:textures/item/lantern.png width:48 height:48 align:center}
&6&lLORE
&fGreybridge failed for practical reasons: routes had no owner, refuges had no honest capacity, and three records described the same disaster differently.
&fNessa wants the island's existing works linked before contradiction becomes infrastructure. Mirelle calls a findable route the first rescue.
&fElias calls a record that survives its author the first rescue.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fComplete any &e3 of 6&f public upgrades below. Upgrade, link, test, or maintain an existing work; a new build is welcome only when no equivalent exists.
&a&lSTANDARD
&fLeave the result usable by a stranger and record one owner, route, or corrective action. Solo logs and self-audits count.
quests.subtitle: Link what already exists. Make one useful thing survive its first failure.

tasks.title: Read the Public-Works Rubric

quests.title: THE ISLAND REMEMBERS

description: &6&lLORE
&fMirelle circles the map where two old roads nearly meet. She does not ask for another road; she asks for the missing sign, bridge, rail spur, or caretaker that makes the old one dependable.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fUpgrade or link an existing route, rail, path, or Via Romana line between two useful locations.
&a&lSTANDARD
&fAn unbriefed traveller can identify both endpoints, follow the signs, and find the maintenance owner. A solo player may log and correct one navigation failure.
quests.subtitle: Link two useful places and prove the link survives a wrong turn.

tasks.title: Carry a rail marker or route token
REVIEW: Route survives a wrong turn and has a named caretaker

quests.title: CONNECTED ROUTE

description: &6&lLORE
&fElias finds Greybridge's oldest contract written on the back of a receipt. Mirelle calls it proof that markets need rules. Elias calls it proof that rules need somewhere public to be read.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fUpgrade an existing market, stall, contract board, or trade room into a public hall with three active offers, services, or contract categories.
&a&lSTANDARD
&fNeutral access, visible terms, and a named steward are present. A solo player may perform and log a test transaction or correct one confusing rule.
quests.subtitle: Turn an existing stall into a place where terms survive the seller.

tasks.title: Place a market token for review
REVIEW: Three active services and a readable public contract

quests.title: MARKET AND CONTRACT HALL

description: &6&lLORE
&fThe workshop survived because somebody labelled one chest. The depot failed because nobody labelled the second.
&fNessa asks for an upgrade joining machine access, repair stock, and a clear line between public and personal tools.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fSubstantially upgrade an existing workshop or depot so two useful capabilities and their public/private stock are obvious.
&a&lSTANDARD
&fTwo capabilities work, operating rules are visible, and a maintainer is named. A solo player may run a repair or processing test and record one corrected failure.
quests.subtitle: Make the useful tools reachable without making them mysteriously vanish.

tasks.title: Bring an andesite-alloy workshop token
REVIEW: Two useful capabilities work and stock boundaries are clear

quests.title: SHARED WORKSHOP AND DEPOT

description: &6&lLORE
&fGreybridge kept three accounts of the same night and trusted none. Elias wants five verifiable memories a later player can compare.
&fMirelle insists the record must also admit what remains uncertain.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fUpgrade an existing archive, map room, memorial, museum, or gallery with five verifiable world facts and a place for the sixth.
&a&lSTANDARD
&fThe facts are browseable, dated or located, and include one uncertainty or correction. A solo player may audit one entry and add its source.
quests.subtitle: Leave the next witness more than your version of events.

tasks.title: Bring a writable archive token
REVIEW: Five sourced memories and one correction are browseable

quests.title: ARCHIVE AND MEMORIAL

description: &6&lLORE
&fGreybridge's refuge was large enough on paper and full enough in practice. Mirelle asks for capacity that can be counted, while Elias asks for an exit that can be found when the lamps are out.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fUpgrade an existing refuge, alarm point, lit retreat, or emergency station and test its capacity, supplies, and exit route.
&a&lSTANDARD
&fThe station is findable under pressure and one failure is corrected. A solo player may self-audit the route and sign the maintenance log.
quests.subtitle: Test the shelter before the island tests it for you.

tasks.title: Carry a readiness lantern
REVIEW: Refuge capacity, exit route, and one corrected failure

quests.title: THREAT REFUGE AND READINESS

description: &6&lLORE
&fThe island's first public event ended at a locked door and a landing field with no safe edge.
&fNessa treats arrival and gathering as one promise: people can reach it, use it, and tell what happened there.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fUpgrade an existing dock, hangar, vehicle depot, meeting room, stage, or event ground into one usable public arrival-and-gathering space.
&a&lSTANDARD
&fMark a safe approach, provide one useful vehicle or venue function, and host or self-audit one event/test with a recorded correction.
quests.subtitle: Give arrivals somewhere to land, gather, and be remembered.

tasks.title: Bring a vehicle or venue token
REVIEW: Safe arrival and one usable public event/test

quests.title: PUBLIC VENUE AND ARRIVAL WORKS

description: &6&lLORE
&fMirelle and Elias stop arguing when the first three works can be used without their builders present. Nessa files the result under Greybridge's missing reconciliation.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fComplete any three of the six public upgrades. Place one record of the finished set in the archive or public depot.
&a&lSTANDARD
&fEach chosen work is usable by a stranger and has a named route, steward, test, or correction. The team reward funds maintenance, not a technology skip.
quests.subtitle: Choose three upgrades. Make the choice legible.

tasks.title: Archive One Record of the Three Public Works

quests.title: THREE THINGS THE ISLAND KEEPS

description: {image:minecraft:textures/item/firework_rocket.png width:48 height:48 align:center}
&d&lLORE
&fGreybridge broke during a public demonstration. Mirelle Voss remembers the bell as a warning; Elias Rook remembers it as permission. Nessa Quill filed both statements under the same date.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fPublish a venue, participants, stop time, cleanup owner, and two formats that everyone can decline without penalty.
&a&lEVENT STANDARD
&fUse reversible props, visible boundaries, and a written result. The ordinary path is two noncombat events; the skirmish is a separate, runtime-unverified option.
quests.subtitle: Prepare the rules, then choose any two harmless formats.

tasks.title: Publish the Rivalry Rules

quests.title: RIVALRY NIGHT

description: &d&lLORE
&fMirelle's copy of the Greybridge notice says: ‘Ring once, then wait.’ Elias's margin says the second ring saved them. The contradiction becomes a banner, not a verdict.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fCreate one reversible poster, banner, exhibit, or museum label that quotes or paraphrases one side of the bell story.
&a&lEVENT STANDARD

&fFor a group, both sides display a piece. For a solo audit, place one display beside a signed note naming the source and its removal time. Do not place it in another player's claim without permission.
quests.subtitle: Make a reversible accusation that can survive daylight.

tasks.title: Display One Reversible Bell Account

quests.title: PROPAGANDA

description: &e&lLORE
&fElias remembers the demonstration failing because the ward was explained after it flashed. The Lantern Order insists the explanation is part of the ward.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fStage a Blood-versus-Holy utility demonstration, route briefing, or support-station test against an environmental target or dummy space.
&a&lEVENT STANDARD

&fFor a group, at least three people can judge or attend. For a solo audit, record the setup, expected result, observed result, and one safe adjustment. No unwilling target, combat spell, or faction change is required.
quests.subtitle: Demonstrate protection without making a person the target.

tasks.title: Record a Safe Ward Test

quests.title: WARD TEST

description: &a&lLORE
&fNessa Quill found three copies of the same route with three different final bells. She kept the maps because the walk mattered more than the answer.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fPlace a short clue course ending at a public project, harmless trophy, or location reveal, then remove or archive every clue.
&a&lEVENT STANDARD
&fFor a group, participants solve the route. For a solo audit, run it against your own recorded time and one failure note. The final record names what was learned and where the clues went.
quests.subtitle: Leave a trail that teaches something when it ends.

tasks.title: Run and Archive a Clue Course

quests.title: CLUE COURSE

description: &b&lLORE
&fThe old courier ledger has two arrival times for the same Greybridge crate. One is written in ink; the other is corrected in charcoal after the bell.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fPublish a start, finish, allowed transport, route, and safety rule for a foot, rail, boat, glider, or vehicle run.
&a&lEVENT STANDARD
&fFor a group, record the route and a visible finish. For a solo audit, run it twice, record the times and one failure/recovery, and leave the route usable for the next courier.
quests.subtitle: Publish the route before anyone starts moving.

tasks.title: Publish and Run a Safe Courier Route

quests.title: COURIER RUN

description: &6&lLORE
&fNessa's archive calls the first Greybridge market a truce. Elias calls it a queue. Mirelle calls it the only hour nobody asked which side rang the bell.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fSet a time window and procurement or service benchmark: gather a real bundle, fill a shortage, or complete a useful delivery.
&a&lEVENT STANDARD
&fFor a group, publish the result and the terms. For a solo audit, record the target, inputs, elapsed time, and actual output. No fake trades, duplicated goods, or currency loop.
quests.subtitle: Measure a service without inventing a transaction.

tasks.title: Publish a Market Benchmark

quests.title: MARKET TEST

description: &f&lLORE
&fThe bell fragment is still displayed beside a half-built arch. Nessa wrote: ‘A structure can be wrong and still be honest if its maker leaves the measurements.’
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fPresent a mascot, one-chunk build, ceremonial object, or public display with a three-line rubric: readable, reversible, and useful or memorable.
&a&lEVENT STANDARD
&fFor a group, invite judges or independent categories. For a solo audit, sign your own score against the rubric and record one change you would make. Keep the object only with its owner's consent.
quests.subtitle: Judge a small object by a stated rule, not by power.

tasks.title: Submit a Rubric-Judged Build

quests.title: BUILD RUBRIC

description: &c&lLORE
&fThe Greybridge demonstration did not end because anyone won. It ended because the crowd could not tell who had agreed to be in danger.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fOnly after two noncombat formats, schedule a fully opt-in skirmish with a roster, loadout ceiling, arena, spectator protection, backup, stop command, and restoration owner.
&a&lEVENT STANDARD
&fThis node is runtime unverified and must remain unused until controls are tested. Completion means a safe end and agreed restoration—not kills, victory, or faction power.
quests.subtitle: Optional hosted PvP; two safe formats first.

tasks.title: Confirm Consent, Backup, and Safe End

quests.title: SANCTIONED SKIRMISH

description: &d&lLORE
&fNessa Quill never corrected Mirelle or Elias. She placed both bell accounts in the same folder and left a blank page for the next witness.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fArchive two event results, the cleanup status, one concrete moment, and one unresolved question or change for next time.
&a&lEVENT STANDARD
&fUse a book, signs, map wall, or archive chest that a late player can find. The archive is reachable without the skirmish; no PvP result is required.
quests.subtitle: After any two safe formats, leave a useful record.

tasks.title: Archive Two Results and One Open Question

quests.title: ARCHIVE THE NIGHT

description: &6&lLORE
&fGreybridge's truce collapsed during a public demonstration. Mirelle Voss and Elias Rook still describe the same bell differently; Nessa Quill archived both versions.
&e&lOBJECTIVE

&fChoose a venue, post the invitation, name hosts and cleanup owners, and display the bell fragment, demonstration ledger, route map, or two witness notes without pretending the contradiction is solved.
&a&lEVENT STANDARD

&fThe preferred fair has visitors and shared stations. A solo preparation audit may use a staged venue, signed hosting plan, and NPC-facing invitation. The six contributions are alternatives; any three complete the fair.
quests.subtitle: Set one place, one time, and one unresolved history on the table.

tasks.title: Post the Fair Plan and Evidence

quests.title: CALL THE FAIR

description: &4&lLORE
&fMirelle's host book lists a bloodless toast beside the bell fragment: ‘We remember differently; sit anyway.’
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fHost a Vampire's Delight table, night-route tour, ritual study, archive reading, or aesthetic exhibit.
&a&lEVENT STANDARD
&fFor the fair, guests participate safely and leave with one remembered detail. For a solo audit, stage the table or exhibit, sign the guest protocol, and record the intended audience or NPC visitor.
quests.subtitle: Give the night a table without asking for allegiance.

tasks.title: Stage Hospitality and a Guest Record

quests.title: HOUSE HOSPITALITY

description: &b&lLORE
&fElias's margin note says the bell was safe only after somebody explained the exit. The Lantern Order turns that note into a public ward lesson.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fHost a safety demonstration, route briefing, rescue drill, countermeasure museum, or support station.
&a&lEVENT STANDARD
&fFor the fair, visitors can practice or learn without being targets. For a solo audit, stage the display against the environment and sign a test log with expected and observed results.
quests.subtitle: Explain a danger before it becomes a spectacle.

tasks.title: Run a Public Safety Demonstration

quests.title: LANTERN SERVICE

description: &a&lLORE
&fNessa's archive calls the first neutral desk a place where both bell accounts could be delivered without changing hands.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fOperate a market, contract desk, courier service, map desk, guesthouse, mediation table, or event logistics station.
&a&lEVENT STANDARD
&fFor the fair, publish terms and complete one real interaction. For a solo audit, post the terms, complete a documented service or route test, and leave the desk ready for a visitor.
quests.subtitle: Make one neutral service actually useful.

tasks.title: Operate One Neutral Service

quests.title: FREE COMPANY MARKET

description: &6&lLORE
&fThe demonstration ledger has a missing line where the bell should have been tested. The workshop fills that gap with an operator, a spectator line, and a failure note.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fDemonstrate a Create system, vehicle, dock, rail feature, workshop, or controlled engineering test.
&a&lEVENT STANDARD
&fFor the fair, explain the system and run it once with marked zones. For a solo audit, stage the display, run the test, and sign the expected result, observed result, and repair hook.
quests.subtitle: Let one machine explain itself before it moves.

tasks.title: Run a Controlled Machine Demonstration

quests.title: ENGINEERING EXHIBITION

description: &e&lLORE
&fA witness remembered the bell by the sound of the crowd afterward. The fair keeps that human detail: a game, ceremony, music cue, or guided tour that ends with someone taking part.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fRun a performance, mini-game, ceremony, award, speech, guided tour, or other shared activity.
&a&lEVENT STANDARD
&fFor the fair, announce how to join and show a visible ending. For a solo audit, stage the activity, write the joining instructions, and record a test run or NPC audience response.
quests.subtitle: Give visitors a reason to participate.

tasks.title: Run a Participatory Showcase

quests.title: PUBLIC SHOWCASE

description: &f&lLORE
&fThe archive does not choose between Mirelle and Elias. It preserves the bell fragment, both witness notes, the demonstration ledger, and the route that led people home.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fPreserve five concrete season facts, images, maps, quotes, results, or failures and identify one unfinished hook.
&a&lEVENT STANDARD
&fFor the fair, make the record browseable for a late player. For a solo audit, sign and file the five entries in a durable archive with a clearly marked next page.
quests.subtitle: Preserve five facts and leave one door open.

tasks.title: File Five Season Facts

quests.title: ARCHIVE THE SEASON

description: &6&lLORE
&fAt the fair's last bell, Mirelle and Elias still disagree. Nessa's blank page is not an invitation to invent a clean answer; it is a promise that the next season may examine the evidence.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fComplete any three fair contributions and record one unresolved pressure or ambition that players genuinely want to continue.
&a&lEVENT STANDARD
&fThe preferred capstone is a real public gathering. A solo seal audit must point to three staged contribution records and one signed sequel hook; it does not pretend a crowd attended.
quests.subtitle: Complete any three contributions, then name what remains unresolved.

tasks.title: Seal the Fair and Leave a Future Hook

quests.title: SEAL SEASON ONE

description: &f&lLORE
&fNessa's final note leaves the two bell accounts side by side. The fair is over; the disagreement is now part of the island's usable history.
&e&lOBJECTIVE
&fPlace the fair record and one genuine future hook in the public archive, then leave a writable page or clearly marked place for the next entry.
&a&lEVENT STANDARD
&fFor a group, announce where the record lives. For a solo audit, verify that a new player can find and understand it without an oral briefing.
quests.subtitle: Put the final record somewhere the next season can find it.

tasks.title: File the Fair's Final Record
REVIEW: Record One Contradiction, Success, and Future Promise

quests.title: ARCHIVE AFTERMATH

&7Lore:&f The Atlas closes the season ledger after the seal. Nessa Quill keeps the post-season courier route open.
&fHer notes remember Greybridge as an earlier failed truce, not a destination the living island must visit.
&fObjective:&f Choose one public service for the team: a festival cache, a hospitality cache, a construction crate, or a neutral research kit.
&fStandard:&f Agree on a payer and a named destination before submitting the visible Bevel price. Each service renews after seven days.

description: {image:minecraft:textures/item/writable_book.png width:48 height:48 align:center}
&f&lARCHIVE A NEW RUMOUR
&7Lore:&f Nessa Quill keeps a spare courier line for stories with a place to begin. Greybridge remains a past failure; the next rumour belongs to the island being built now.
&fObjective:&f Write a short rumour tied to one real location, ambition, dispute, settlement, threat, machine, public work, or mystery.
&fEnd it with one actionable question.
&fStandard:&f The entry is specific enough for another player to act on next session. This trust-based archive renews every seven days and grants exactly 1 team Bevel.
quests.subtitle: One place, one actionable question, exactly one team Bevel weekly.

tasks.title: I Added One Actionable Rumour

quests.title: ARCHIVE A NEW RUMOUR

description: {image:minecraft:textures/item/filled_map.png width:48 height:48 align:center}
&e&lLEAVE A SEASON TWO PRESSURE
&7Lore:&f Nessa will carry one pressure forward, but she will not invent a destination for people who have already moved on. The old Greybridge failure is context, not a required return trip.
&fObjective:&f Record one unresolved pressure, its stakeholders, and evidence that players care about it.
&fStandard:&f Add one practical supply cache that would make the chosen hook playable next season.
quests.subtitle: Leave a pressure with a place, people, and a reason to return.
